thread:
sam: starting KnitWave rollout (v2.14.0 candidate) — staged -> canary -> full. ordering: api, runtime, router, console. pinging owners for preflight thumbs.

maria: runtime notes: batching kernel flip and KV eviction tuning in this build (runtime:v2.14.0-rc3). I ran microbenchmarks for our 8k-seq workload; memory and p95 look fine but want to bump KV TTL during canary to reduce eviction noise.

alex: router needs console header-split flag on before we do header-based routing. otherwise we risk misrouting clients that expect old header format.

irene: console has a schema change behind a feature-flag. local smoke passed, but saw one flaky 502 in staging earlier when header-split flag was off. re-running preflight.

sam: rollback criteria proposal: any service hits 5xx > 0.5% sustained over 5m OR p95 latency regression > 10% compared to baseline for 5m. If triggered, rollback that service and pause wave. Sound good?

maria: agreed. I'll also add an automated perf-probe to auto-bail if p95 > +8% during canary.

alex: router will gate on a console ack. i'll hold router pin until console confirms header-split guarded.

deploy-bot: deploy queued by sam: /deploy knitwave v2.14.0 --staged --owners @sam,@maria,@alex,@irene --order api,runtime,router,console

ops-lead: note for triage: prefer unpinning console first if schema/runtime mismatch shows up — console changes are behind flag and backward compatible.

deploy-bot: staged deploy completed: api:v2.14.0 staged -> OK

sam: starting API canary 10%

deploy-bot: canary (api) started: api:v2.14.0 -> 10% traffic

maria: runtime staged and canarying with TTL bump: RUNTIME_KV_TTL=180m for canary. runtime canary started: runtime:v2.14.0-rc3 -> 10%

maria: quick perf probe: qps steady, p95 +3%, cpu +6% — within thresholds. eviction rate down after TTL bump.

irene: re-ran console staging smoke; reproducing a 502 on try #3 when header-split flag off. stack shows NPE in header parser. pushing a small guard fix now.

alex: ack. router will wait. holding router canary until console confirmation.

sam: hold router/console. continue api/runtime canary to 50% while console hotfix lands.

deploy-bot: canary update: api:v2.14.0 -> 50%, runtime:v2.14.0-rc3 -> 50%

maria: metrics at 50% look stable: api p95 +4%, errors 0.12%. runtime p95 +4%.

irene: pushed guard patch and deployed hotfix to staging.

deploy-bot: console hotfix staging deploy finished

irene: staging smoke after hotfix is clean for 30m, no 502s. ready for canary. added a preflight test to check header parse guard.

alex: enabling header-swap flag in router staging and will run compatibility checks against console hotfix. if green, i'll start router canary.

deploy-bot: api/runtime at 50% stable according to automated canary checks.

sam: decision: push API/runtime to 100% now. keep router/console blocked until router validates header-split. release notes draft: "KnitWave v2.14.0 — batching kernel, KV TTL tuning, console header-split behind flag. No expected downtime."

maria: add migration note: "Customers using custom headers should verify header-split compatibility."

deploy-bot: progressing to 100%: api:v2.14.0 -> 100% ; runtime:v2.14.0-rc3 -> 100%

maria: runtime rolled to 100%. monitoring for 30m. alerts armed for next 2 hours.

alex: router staging tests with header flag passed. starting router canary 10% against console hotfix

deploy-bot: router canary started: router:v1.10.0-canary -> 10%

irene: console canary with hotfix on flagged path is live. login smoke green.

deploy-bot: router 10% metrics: tail latency +2%, no increase in 5xx

alex: going to 50%

deploy-bot: router 50% -> metrics stable.

sam: once router at 50% and console smoke holds for 15m, proceed console to 100% and finalize release. ensure changelog and release notes published.

ops-lead: reminder: tag any regressions in incidents channel. post-deploy checklist: confirm telemetry baselines, ensure error budgets, close rollback window.

maria: monitoring looks good at 30m post-run for runtime.

deploy-bot: router -> 100% complete

deploy-bot: console -> 100% complete

sam: KnitWave v2.14.0 rolled to prod successfully. good job. retro tomorrow 10am — action items: add header-split smoke to preflight, add router->console contract test, and auto-perf bail for p95 +8%.

irene: adding header parse smoke to automated preflight scripts. :white_check_mark:

alex: adding router->console contract tests to CI.

maria: adding perf-probe to canary pipeline for auto-bail.

ops-lead: logged rollout in release tracker; no rollback required. :thumbsup:
